content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Electric power generation and telecom services in rural Alaska; not a water utility."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Regulated drinking water and wastewater utility serving homes and businesses in neighboring Delaware and Maryland."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures water meters and flow instruments and sells software; it is an equipment supplier, not a water utility operator."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Commercial landscape maintenance and irrigation services; no water or wastewater utility operations."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Contract construction and maintenance of gas, electric and fiber networks for utilities; not a utility operator."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Regulated natural gas and electric distribution plus propane; a different energy utility business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Regulated electric, gas and steam delivery utility; different energy utility business."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Regulated potable water and wastewater utility serving residential and commercial customers, with contract-like developer agreements."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Building mechanical, electrical and plumbing installation and maintenance services; not a utility."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Fiber internet, phone and video provider; telecom business with no water operations."}]}
